title: Capital Credits Accounting Note — Payable of an Elected Pass-Through Row under a Discounted Early Retirement
content:
# Payable of an Elected Pass-Through Row under a Discounted Early Retirement

*Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) — accounting note.*

## Valuation clause

The payable of an elected pass-through row is its gross, the pass-through amount of that allocation year still unretired, discounted at the patron class's early retirement discount rate a year, compounded once a year, over the whole number of years from the calendar year of the election to the year the row would be retired in the general rotation, its allocation year plus the class's expected rotation years, never fewer than zero years, less the request's refiling fee where it is still owed; the payable is rounded half up to the cent and never below zero.

## The request's refiling fee

The request's refiling fee is owed once per request by a member who withdrew or was denied an earlier discounted early retirement request on the account, one such request costing $5.00 and two or more costing $10.00, and it is deducted from the first row booked under the approved request, so an elected row carries it only when no payable entry of that request stands on the account yet.

| Earlier discounted early retirement requests on the account withdrawn or denied | Payable entry of the approved request already on the account | Fee on the elected row |
|---|---|---|
| none | either | none |
| one | none | $5.00 |
| two or more | none | $10.00 |
| one or more | one or more | none |

## Terms of the clause

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Request | the member's discounted early retirement request on the account in board-approved status, the most recently submitted where there are several |
| Row | one wholesale-supplier pass-through allocation year of the account |
| Gross | the pass-through amount of that year as booked, less every general retirement already booked on that pass-through year |
| Year of the election | the calendar year in which the row is elected |
| Years of discount | the whole years from the year of the election to the allocation year plus the class's expected rotation years; zero where that year is the year of the election or earlier |

**Order of the figures.** One plus the rate, as a decimal, is raised to the power of the years of discount and the gross is divided by the result; any refiling fee still owed is then subtracted; the outcome is rounded half up to the cent, and a negative outcome is taken as zero.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

The rate of 6 percent and the expected rotation of 20 years are assumed for this illustration only. A 2010 pass-through allocation of $140.00, nothing yet retired, is elected in 2026; its rotation year is 2030, four whole years away.

1. 1.06 raised to the power 4 is 1.262477.
2. $140.00 divided by 1.262477 is $110.893.
3. The member had one earlier request withdrawn, and no payable entry of the approved request stands on the account yet: less $5.00 gives $105.893.
4. Rounded half up: **$105.89**.

Had a payable entry of the approved request already stood on the account, step 3 would take nothing and the payable would be **$110.89**.
